name: Sovereign Whipblade
description: Salute the foe with the point and settle into the school's first guard in the same smooth motion.

name: Voltegrace
description: Advance with the school's measured pace that keeps the shoulders square and the point on the centre line.

name: Clement Cuphilt
description: Observe the foe's line of attack and note where two tracks of defence can be laid across it.

name: Venerable Cupedge
description: Turn the foe's thrust off the court line with the forte and strike back before he recovers.

name: Pallvolte
description: Slip under the foe's blade in a smooth azure curve and thrust where his guard has just left.

name: Pealfoil
description: Beat the foe's blade twice in an even pair to shake it from its line.

name: Prismremise
description: Lunge along the ruled court line with qi in the leading leg so the point lands before the foe sets.

name: Parity Tipwhip
description: Hold two tracks of guard against a flurry then answer on whichever track the foe leaves open.

name: Radiance Sweephilt
description: Flash across the gap on a surge of qi and land the court thrust before the foe has seen it start.

name: Vaunted Stoccata
description: Salute and open the line with the first point then answer the foe's parry with the second in the school's culminating form.

name: Sainted Bellguard
description: Stand with the blade raised and the free hand lifted behind it like the two wings of a hawk.

name: Skyborne Remise
description: Step on two quick pinion strides so the feet land in a pair as the arm extends.

name: Interstice Needlepoint
description: Watch the foe's blade and his front foot together and name which of them will move first.

name: Pasguard Edict
description: Lunge with the point and let the free hand's qi follow a breath behind it as a second strike.

name: Foilvow
description: Beat the foe's thrust aside with a stroke as sudden as a wingbeat and recover the guard.

name: Authoritative Lunge
description: Rake the point at the foe's eyes like a talon to draw his guard high.

name: Bedrock Passata
description: Hold both point and free hand over the foe's guard and press down until it sags.

name: Slimtang Verdict
description: Strike the foe's lead arm with the point and pin his stance with a talon of qi from the free hand.

name: Faithful Sweephilt
description: Close the two arms like folding wings around the foe's blade and hold it against his body.

name: Noble Cuphilt
description: Drop both point and qi together from the high guard so the foe cannot parry both.

name: Paramount Fleche
description: Gather the school's two thrusts above the foe and let them descend as one fall that the high guard cannot stop.

name: Steelswept
description: Hold the blade steady and sloped like a bank that turns aside the river's pull.

name: Vigor Lunge
description: Walk on light feet as through shallows so that no step sinks or stalls the body.

name: Reminiscence Tipwhip
description: Read the foe's movement from the way light moves on his blade as it does on water.

name: Majestic Bellguard
description: Cross the gap in two plain steps as across a ford and finish with a lunge to the chest.

name: Venerable Pasguard
description: Draw the parry from the hip like a spring rising and let the riposte run forward from it.

name: Subjugating Volte
description: Lay the forte across the foe's blade like a bar of sand that halts its current.

name: Entropy Volte
description: Turn the foe's blade with a sweep like a current and carry it out of his grasp.

name: Pulsar Whipblade
description: Hold the point low while qi swells like rising water then loose it upward in a single thrust.

name: Vacuum Slimtang
description: Cut a channel of qi along the line of the thrust so the foe's escape paths are sealed.

name: Prism Counterpoise
description: Close river and basin about the foe from two sides so every route off the line is shut and the point strikes.

name: Peerless Counterpoise
description: Hold the blade on the left track so the foe's thrust must find the narrow right line.

name: Mighty Cuphilt
description: Hold the blade on the right track so the foe's thrust must find the narrow left line.

name: Deluge Remise
description: Step across from one track to the other without lifting the point from the foe's centre.

name: Clement Tipwhip
description: Hold the eyes on the foe's hip and feel both tracks of his motion from it.

name: Prismlunge
description: Weave the point across both tracks in a quick braid and finish on the line left open.

name: Deluge Needlepoint
description: Cross the blade over the free arm to catch a thrust upon the pair of them.

name: Pall Cupedge
description: Switch back over the foe's blade just as he commits his parry and thrust into the gap.

name: Passata Decree
description: Pin the foe to one track by pressing the point to the other until he must choose.

name: Seasonvolte
description: Parry on the first track and thrust on the second so both answers land in a single beat.

name: Destiny Lunge
description: Beat one track shut with a pulse of qi and send the point down the other.

name: Steel Fleche
description: Thrust so that the point threatens both tracks at its farthest reach and cannot be parried upon either.

name: Steellunge
description: Run the whole school's pair of tracks to one point so the final answer meets the foe on whichever line he guards.

name: Sweptpledge
description: Hold the field outspread like a pinion on either side of the blade as a screen against the foe.

name: Vigor Slimtang
description: Step in long smooth strides and let the field spread wide behind the moving feet.

name: Eclipse Needlepoint
description: Feel the whole open air about the duel through the field and notice what stirs in it.

name: Vacuum Stoccata
description: Lunge with the field spread behind the arm like a pinion pushing the point forward.

name: Parityswept
description: Sweep a broad pinion of field across the blade to clear a flurry of thrusts.

name: Stoccata Vow
description: Lay the field over the foe's blade at its tip and hold it fast against his guard.

name: Entropy Fleche
description: Send a wide arc of field high as if to strike the head and thrust to the belly.

name: Vacuum Whipblade
description: Gather the field wide and loose it through the point in one thrust the foe sees only as a glint.

name: Parityfoil
description: Wrap the field about the body like a cloak of sky and turn the foe's attack to nothing.

name: Thunderclap Passata
description: Flash through the open air on the spread field and strike from an angle the foe does not guard.

name: Sovereign Steel Counterpoise
description: Spread the school's pinion to the whole sky about the foe and thrust through the centre of it.

name: Bedrock Pasguard
description: Hold steel and a point of qi before the body so two points face the foe at once.

name: Bedrock Bellguard
description: Step with the formed Core steady at the centre so the body glides without a sway.

name: Pealswept
description: Feel the foe's Core and his blade together and notice which of the two moves first.

name: Royal Remise
description: Draw qi from the Core into a lunge so the point carries the weight of the whole body.

name: Peal Sweephilt
description: Turn two thrusts at once by meeting one with the steel and the other with the point of qi.

name: Thrall Needlepoint
description: Bind the foe's blade between the steel and a ring of qi from the Core.

name: Thunderclap Pasguard
description: Hide a second thrust of qi inside the first so that the foe's parry meets only one.

name: Thunderclap Lunge
description: Ring the steel with a pulse from the Core to jar the foe's blade and thrust after it.

name: Valiant Cuphilt
description: Seal the foe's lines with one point of qi and strike through the last with the second.

name: Noble Thunderclap Cupedge
description: Drive two points from one Core in the same instant so that the foe's single guard is passed by one.

name: Passeal
description: Plant the feet and lift the point toward the foe as though swearing the first oath of the plateau.

name: Bedrock Stoccata
description: Step toward the foe into the wind with the shoulders low and the point held level.

name: Slimtang Mercy
description: Look at the foe with the broad calm gaze of one who watches the plateau for weather.

name: Volte Decree
description: Lunge with the oath behind it so the point goes only where it was pledged to go.

name: Devout Whipblade
description: Turn on the oath foot to sweep a thrust aside and keep the bearing.

name: Sigil Fleche
description: Knot the foe's blade against the hilt with a quick winding turn of the forte.

name: Phantasm Sweephilt
description: Hold the breath and flick the point at the throat then strike the belly when the foe flinches.

name: Vacuumremise
description: Break the foe's guard with a sworn blow and thrust through the opening the moment it gapes.

name: Peal Cupedge
description: Throw a gust of qi behind the parry so that the foe's blade is pinned out wide for a breath.

name: Season Counterpoise
description: Cross the open ground in a flash of qi and strike once from the wind-sworn guard.

name: Sovereign Bellguard Banner
description: Swear the school's first oath and deliver it as a lunge that follows a feint with no pause between them.

name: Titan Tipwhip
description: Set the guard on a fixed bearing across the plateau and let no pressure turn the blade from it.

name: Flecheodyssey
description: Step along an imagined ridge line toward the foe without a wobble of the shoulders.

name: Pealpas
description: Read the foe's motion as one reads a cloud shadow moving over open ground.

name: Thunderclap Counterpoise
description: Lunge so that the front foot and the point stay on the bearing from start to end.

name: Pallpas
description: Turn the blade over the ridge of the foe's thrust and send it down the far side.

name: Peremptory Slimtang
description: Beat across the foe's bearing with a sharp stroke so he loses his heading for a moment.

name: Quenched Lunge
description: Drive qi along the bearing in a thrust that splits the foe's guard cleanly in two.

name: Sweptvow
description: Meet the foe's thrust like a wind at a plateau edge and counter along the rim of his arm.

name: Pulsarpas
description: Flash along the bearing in one burst of qi and pierce the line the foe has drawn.

name: Peerless Needlepoint
description: Hold the bearing through every turn and breath of the duel until the final thrust arrives along it.

name: Steel Sweephilt
description: Hold a wide guard on bare open ground with the point free and the back unprotected.

name: Deluge Passata
description: Pace across open field with long steady strides that use every inch of room.

name: Sweptgift
description: Sight the foe against the open air and judge his reach by how much sky shows past him.

name: Volition Whipblade
description: Hold the wrist free and loose so that the point can turn from any side without strain.

name: Cuphilt Verdict
description: Run through the gap the foe leaves and thrust as the second stride lands.

name: Pallswept
description: Sweep the whole arm wide to clear thrusts and use all the room the open ground gives.

name: Pasvow
description: Feint a retreat toward open ground so that the foe lunges after you onto an empty line.

name: Magnificent Remise
description: Walk forward with the point steady as a wind pressing on the foe's chest.

name: Thunderclap Volte
description: Gather qi on open ground and loose a thrust that goes where no cover can turn it.

name: Squallswept
description: Parry with the whole span of the arm and counter into the line the wide parry has opened.

name: Thunderclap Bellguard
description: Flash across the open field and strike before the foe can step back out of the reach.

name: Famed Passata Crown
description: Cross open ground in the school's final form and finish with a thrust no cover or retreat can avoid.

name: Prismfoil
description: Hold the blade slanted across the line like a post set against a side wind.

name: Windborne Cupedge
description: Step in at a slant to the foe's line so the body comes from the side like a gust.

name: Pasguard Blessing
description: Watch the dust eddy about the foe's feet and read from it which way he will turn.

name: Prism Tipwhip
description: Lunge at a slant across the foe's line so the point comes from a side he does not guard.

name: Inviolate Needlepoint
description: Parry at a slant that lets the thrust slide down the blade and past the shoulder.

name: Peal Fleche
description: Beat the foe's blade from one side then slip round it to the other in a single gust.

name: Unbending Volte
description: Turn the foe's steel in a crosswind sweep that leaves his hand and point on the wrong line.

name: Lungeedict
description: Parry and thrust in one slanting motion so the wind that turns the foe also drives the point.

name: Remise Grace
description: Flash in from the side in one gust of qi and strike where the foe's attention is not.

name: Fearless Thunderclap Sweephilt
description: Come at the foe from the side in the school's final form so that every parry is made on the wrong line.

name: Statute Bellguard
description: Stand with the oath sworn and the living field spread level about the blade like a held gale.

name: Squalllunge
description: Step on the wind of the field so that the feet seem to be pushed from behind.

name: Compassionate Counterpoise
description: Feel across the open plateau with the field for any blade or step that stirs within it.

name: Majestic Cupedge
description: Lunge with the whole field behind the arm like a gale at the back of a runner.

name: Pall Cuphilt
description: Brush the foe's thrust wide with a stroke that carries the wind of the oath.

name: Thunderous Stoccata
description: Wrap the field about the foe's blade and hold it to the line of your own.

name: Voltevow
description: Swear a thrust to one side with a gust of field and make the true thrust on the other.

name: Radiance Pasguard
description: Gather the sworn gale behind the point and loose it through a guard that the steel alone could not pass.

name: Undefiled Tipwhip
description: Spread the field before the blade so that the foe's gathered force is stilled before it arrives.

name: Thunderclap Fleche
description: Burst forward on a gale of the field and land the sworn thrust before the foe can turn.

name: Steelvolte
description: Send the whole sworn gale of the school through the point in a thrust that pins the foe where he stands.

name: Prism Cuphilt
description: Stand upon the formed Core as on a high plateau with the blade level and steady before the body.

name: Squall Passata
description: Step on a breath drawn from the Core so that each stride is carried by the wind of it.

name: Pasbenison
description: Feel the bearing of the foe through the Core and keep the point turned upon it.

name: Bloomswept
description: Hold a long breath at the Core to steady the arm and thicken the qi in the point.

name: Vacuum Lunge
description: Lunge on a gust drawn up from the Core so the thrust lands with its full pressure.

name: Parity Slimtang
description: Parry with a surge of gale from the Core that shoves the foe's blade far off the line.

name: Thrall Cupedge
description: Bind the foe's blade with a sworn coil of qi from the Core and hold it still.

name: Phantasm Remise
description: Pulse the Core as though to lunge and hold back so the foe commits to a parry too soon.

name: Pulsarfoil
description: Let the held wind of the Core go all at once through the point in a single piercing thrust.

name: Venerable Sweephilt
description: Sweep a gale of qi across the guard line to clear every thrust and pin the foe's blade.

name: Radiance Stoccata
description: Flash across the plateau on the Core's gale and strike once before the foe can raise his guard.

name: Majestic Volte Verdict
description: Unbind the full wind of the plateau through the formed Core in a sequence ending in one unstoppable thrust.
